resources.name: RentFlow Backend
resources.description: Complete RentFlow backend API collection for local development.

resources.name: Login
resources.description: Uses the seeded local admin. If your Insomnia version does not run response scripts, copy accessToken from the response into the access_token environment variable.

resources.name: List Customers
resources.description: Optional query params: status=ACTIVE|BLACKLISTED|INACTIVE, searchTerm. Requires CUSTOMER_VIEW.

resources.name: Create Customer
resources.description: Requires CUSTOMER_CREATE. Copy the returned id into customer_id.

resources.name: List Vehicles
resources.description: Optional query params: status, categoryId, sortBy. Requires FLEET_VIEW.

resources.name: Register Vehicle
resources.description: Uses the seeded Economy category by default. Requires FLEET_CREATE. Copy the returned id into vehicle_id.

resources.name: Update Vehicle Status
resources.description: Allowed statuses: AVAILABLE, RENTED, MAINTENANCE, OUT_OF_SERVICE. Requires FLEET_EDIT.

resources.name: Delete Vehicle
resources.description: Soft-deactivates the vehicle by setting OUT_OF_SERVICE. Requires FLEET_DELETE.

resources.name: Upload Vehicle Photo
resources.description: Select a file in the multipart body before sending. Requires FLEET_EDIT.

resources.name: Create Category
resources.description: Requires FLEET_CREATE. Copy the returned id into category_id if you want to use the new category.

resources.name: List Reservations
resources.description: Optional query params: status, from, to. Requires RESERVATION_VIEW.

resources.name: Create Reservation
resources.description: Requires RESERVATION_CREATE. Copy the returned id into reservation_id.

resources.name: Get Reservation Calendar
resources.description: Optional query param: categoryId. Requires RESERVATION_VIEW.

resources.name: Apply Reservation Discount
resources.description: discountPercent is 0.0 to 1.0. Requires RESERVATION_EDIT; larger discounts may require RESERVATION_APPROVE_DISCOUNT.

resources.name: List Contracts
resources.description: Optional query params: status, vehicleId, customerId. Requires CONTRACT_VIEW.

resources.name: Open Contract
resources.description: Requires CONTRACT_CREATE. Copy the returned id into contract_id.

resources.name: Record Pickup
resources.description: Fuel levels: EMPTY, QUARTER, HALF, THREE_QUARTERS, FULL. Requires CONTRACT_CREATE.

resources.description: Damage severity: MINOR, MODERATE, MAJOR. Liability: CUSTOMER, AGENCY, THIRD_PARTY, INSURANCE. Requires CONTRACT_CLOSE.

resources.name: Upload Contract Photo
resources.description: Select a file in the multipart body before sending. Requires CONTRACT_CREATE.

resources.name: List Damage Reports
resources.description: Optional query params: status=OPEN|UNDER_REPAIR|SETTLED|CLOSED, vehicleId. Requires MAINTENANCE_VIEW.

resources.name: Create Damage Report
resources.description: Requires MAINTENANCE_CREATE. Copy the returned id into damage_report_id.

resources.name: Upload Damage Report Photo
resources.description: Select a file in the multipart body before sending. Requires MAINTENANCE_CREATE.

resources.name: List Deposits
resources.description: Optional query params: status=HELD|RELEASED|FORFEITED, customerId. Requires PAYMENT_VIEW.

resources.name: List Invoices
resources.description: Optional query params: status, customerId, contractId, from, to. Requires PAYMENT_VIEW.

resources.name: Record Payment
resources.description: Payment methods: CASH, CARD, BANK_TRANSFER, ONLINE. Requires PAYMENT_RECORD.

resources.name: Request Refund
resources.description: Refund reasons: CANCELLATION, OVERPAYMENT, DAMAGE_RESOLUTION, GOODWILL, OTHER. Payment methods: CASH, CARD, BANK_TRANSFER, ONLINE. Requires PAYMENT_RECORD. Copy the returned id into refund_id.

resources.name: Mark Notification Read
resources.description: Marks one notification read for the authenticated staff member.

resources.name: Mark All Notifications Read
resources.description: Marks all notifications read for the authenticated staff member.

resources.name: Create Template
resources.description: Triggers: RESERVATION_CREATED, RESERVATION_CONFIRMED, RESERVATION_CANCELLED, CONTRACT_OPENED, PICKUP_RECORDED, RETURN_RECORDED, INVOICE_SENT, INVOICE_PAID, DEPOSIT_RELEASED, DOCUMENT_EXPIRING, MAINTENANCE_DUE, RETURN_OVERDUE. Channels: EMAIL, SMS, IN_APP. Requires SETTINGS_EDIT. Copy the returned id into template_id.

resources.name: Create Automation Rule
resources.description: Requires SETTINGS_EDIT. Copy the returned id into automation_rule_id.

resources.name: Export Fleet Utilization
resources.description: format can be CSV or PDF. Requires REPORT_EXPORT.

resources.name: Export Revenue
resources.description: format can be CSV or PDF. Requires REPORT_EXPORT.
